;M01

PROFILE
G01 X300. Y0.
CORNER
G01 X300. Y200.
CORNER
G01 X0. Y200.
CORNER
LASTLINE(0,0,0,1,0.,200.,0.,0.,0,0)

	  STOPRE
	  R16=0
   GOTOB CICLA
ENDIF
